<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game'), ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const stage = document.getElementById('stage');
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const spells = [
    {name:'Ember bolt',desc:'A seeking flame',unlock:1,color:'#ffbb71',damage:22,rate:.48,speed:370,size:7,count:1},
    {name:'Moon shard',desc:'Piercing lunar glass',unlock:2,color:'#9bd8f1',damage:17,rate:.62,speed:440,size:6,count:2,pierce:1},
    {name:'Briar ring',desc:'Thorns bloom around you',unlock:4,color:'#a7e58a',damage:24,rate:.85,speed:270,size:8,count:3},
    {name:'Starfall',desc:'A little cosmic ruin',unlock:6,color:'#e2a8ff',damage:48,rate:1.05,speed:320,size:10,count:1,pierce:2}
  ];
  const keys = new Set(); let W=960,H=600,dpr=1,last=0,elapsed=0,spawnTimer=1.5,castTimer=0,damageTimer=0,shake=0;
  let running=false,paused=false,selected=0,joy={x:0,y:0},casting=false,messageTimer=0;
  let player,enemies=[],shots=[],particles=[],decor=[],score=0,kills=0,wave=1,night=1,spawned=0;
  const rand=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a), clamp=(n,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,n));
  function resize(){const r=stage.getBoundingClientRect();dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);W=r.width;H=r.height;canvas.width=Math.round(W*dpr);canvas.height=Math.round(H*dpr);ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);makeDecor()}
  function makeDecor(){decor=[];for(let i=0;i<Math.floor(W*H/3900);i++){decor.push({x:rand(12,W-12),y:rand(12,H-12),r:rand(2,7),type:Math.random()})}}
  function reset(){player={x:W/2,y:H/2,hp:100,maxHp:100,level:1,xp:0,next:30,face:1};enemies=[];shots=[];particles=[];kills=0;score=0;wave=1;night=1;spawned=0;elapsed=0;spawnTimer=.9;castTimer=0;damageTimer=0;selected=0;paused=false;running=true;updateHud();selectSpell(0);}
  function updateHud(){ $('hpText').textContent=`${Math.ceil(player.hp)} / ${player.maxHp}`;$('hpBar').style.width=`${100*player.hp/player.maxHp}%`;$('levelText').textContent=player.level;$('xpText').textContent=`${player.xp} / ${player.next}`;$('xpBar').style.width=`${100*player.xp/player.next}%`;$('waveText').textContent=wave;$('nightText').textContent=['I','II','III','IV','V','VI'][Math.min(5,night-1)]; }
  function selectSpell(i){if(!spells[i]||player&&spells[i].unlock>player.level)return;selected=i;document.querySelectorAll('.spell').forEach((el,n)=>el.classList.toggle('active',n===i));$('spellTitle').textContent=spells[i].name;$('spellDesc').textContent=spells[i].desc;$('castBtn').textContent=['✧','☾','❋','✹'][i]}
  function toast(text){const el=$('message');el.textContent=text;el.classList.add('show');messageTimer=2.2}
  function spawnEnemy(){const edge=Math.floor(Math.random()*4),pad=32;let x=edge===0?-pad:edge===1?W+pad:rand(0,W),y=edge===2?-pad:edge===3?H+pad:rand(0,H);const type= Math.random() < Math.min(.25,.08+night*.025)?'brute':Math.random()<.30?'wisp':'mossling';let e={x,y,type,r:type==='brute'?19:type==='wisp'?11:14,hp:type==='brute'?74:type==='wisp'?24:38,max:type==='brute'?74:type==='wisp'?24:38,speed:type==='brute'?30:type==='wisp'?57:43,damage:type==='brute'?18:10,value:type==='brute'?18:type==='wisp'?9:10,hit:0,phase:rand(0,6.28)};e.hp+=Math.max(0,night-1)*7;e.max=e.hp;enemies.push(e);spawned++}
  function addParticles(x,y,color,n=8,power=90){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let a=rand(0,Math.PI*2),v=rand(power*.25,power);particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,life:rand(.25,.7),max:.7,color,r:rand(1.5,4)})}}
  function cast(){if(!running||paused||!player)return;const sp=spells[selected];if(castTimer>0)return;castTimer=sp.rate;let target=null,dist=Infinity;for(const e of enemies){let d=Math.hypot(e.x-player.x,e.y-player.y);if(d<dist){dist=d;target=e}}
    let angle=target?Math.atan2(target.y-player.y,target.x-player.x):Math.atan2(joy.y||0,joy.x||player.face);if(!target&&Math.abs(joy.x)+Math.abs(joy.y)<.1)angle=player.face>0?0:Math.PI;
    if(selected===2){for(let i=0;i<sp.count;i++){let a=angle+(i-1)*.48;shots.push({x:player.x+Math.cos(a)*16,y:player.y+Math.sin(a)*16,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp.speed,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp.speed,life:1.25,damage:sp.damage,color:sp.color,r:sp.size,pierce:0,hit:[]})}}
    else for(let i=0;i<sp.count;i++){let a=angle+(i-(sp.count-1)/2)*.13;shots.push({x:player.x+Math.cos(a)*15,y:player.y+Math.sin(a)*15,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp.speed,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp.speed,life:1.6,damage:sp.damage,color:sp.color,r:sp.size,pierce:sp.pierce||0,hit:[]})}
    addParticles(player.x+Math.cos(angle)*15,player.y+Math.sin(angle)*15,sp.color,4,50);
  }
  function damageEnemy(e,amount){e.hp-=amount;e.hit=.12;addParticles(e.x,e.y,'#f3d9a0',3,45);if(e.hp<=0){enemies.splice(enemies.indexOf(e),1);kills++;score+=e.value;addParticles(e.x,e.y,e.type==='wisp'?'#9bd8f1':'#a7d987',12,110);player.xp+=e.value;while(player.xp>=player.next){player.xp-=player.next;player.level++;player.next=Math.round(player.next*1.35);player.hp=Math.min(player.maxHp,player.hp+22);toast(`Level ${player.level} — magic deepens`);if(spells.some(s=>s.unlock===player.level))setTimeout(()=>toast(`${spells.find(s=>s.unlock===player.level).name} discovered!`),850);for(let i=0;i<spells.length;i++){document.querySelectorAll('.spell')[i].classList.toggle('locked',spells[i].unlock>player.level)}if(spells[selected].unlock>player.level)selectSpell(spells.findIndex(s=>s.unlock<=player.level));}updateHud()}}
  function step(dt){if(!running||paused)return;elapsed+=dt;castTimer-=dt;damageTimer-=dt;spawnTimer-=dt;if(messageTimer>0){messageTimer-=dt;if(messageTimer<=0)$('message').classList.remove('show')}
    const speed=190;let mx=(keys.has('ArrowRight')||keys.has('d')?1:0)-(keys.has('ArrowLeft')||keys.has('a')?1:0)+joy.x,my=(keys.has('ArrowDown')||keys.has('s')?1:0)-(keys.has('ArrowUp')||keys.has('w')?1:0)+joy.y;let mag=Math.hypot(mx,my);if(mag>1){mx/=mag;my/=mag}player.x=clamp(player.x+mx*speed*dt,24,W-24);player.y=clamp(player.y+my*speed*dt,45,H-24);if(mx)player.face=mx>0?1:-1;
    if((keys.has(' ')||casting)&&castTimer<=0)cast();
    if(spawnTimer<=0&&enemies.length<Math.min(14,4+night*2)){spawnEnemy();spawnTimer=Math.max(.56,1.35-night*.07-rand(0,.35))}
    if(spawned>=10+(wave-1)*5&&enemies.length===0){wave++;if(wave%3===0){night++;toast(`Night ${night} descends`)}spawned=0;updateHud()}
    for(const e of [...enemies]){e.hit=Math.max(0,e.hit-dt);e.phase+=dt*3;let dx=player.x-e.x,dy=player.y-e.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;e.x+=dx/d*e.speed*dt;e.y+=dy/d*e.speed*dt;if(d<e.r+14&&damageTimer<=0){player.hp-=e.damage;damageTimer=.8;shake=8;addParticles(player.x,player.y,'#ff8b76',9,90);updateHud();if(player.hp<=0){player.hp=0;endGame()}}}
    for(const s of [...shots]){s.life-=dt;s.x+=s.vx*dt;s.y+=s.vy*dt;for(const e of [...enemies])if(!s.hit.includes(e)&&Math.hypot(e.x-s.x,e.y-s.y)<e.r+s.r){s.hit.push(e);damageEnemy(e,s.damage);if(s.pierce>0)s.pierce--;else{s.life=0;break}}if(s.life<=0||s.x<-30||s.y<-30||s.x>W+30||s.y>H+30)shots.splice(shots.indexOf(s),1)}
    for(const p of [...particles]){p.life-=dt;p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vx*=.96;p.vy*=.96;if(p.life<=0)particles.splice(particles.indexOf(p),1)}if(shake>0)shake=Math.max(0,shake-dt*22);
  }
